description: List the customer's recent Fold orders (most recent first, max 10). If the customer has connected their Fold account to this assistant, returns each order's code, status, dates and address — no email needed. Without a connected account, only says how many recent orders exist (order codes are never revealed from an email alone, for privacy) — use the order code from the customer's confirmation text/email with track_order, or ask them to connect Fold.

email.description: Customer email. Only used when the customer has NOT connected their Fold account; then only a count is returned.

name: list_my_orders
title: List my orders
